body:
[A160] Hosted builder jobs previously skipped the compiler-backed firmware instruments when no supported RV32 compiler was present. Both direct consumers now install and verify the pinned Bootlin SDK, then require the existing absolute selector to adopt it. The deliberately compiler-absent path remains executable and visibly weaker.

Closes #504

Executor A160 Codex; independent reviewers R227 internal Codex and R228 external Opus; manager A10.

## Status and validation

Complete local source bar at `3d90958f3a82ca2a9617112c107a22f332117e17`: 48 static/builder commands plus five native groups pass. The fresh SDK, cache, compiled and absent controls pass separately; exact tools and original head attribution remain in the evidence comment. The complete builder uses an explicit audited argv0 mapping to a disposable SDK. This proves local compatibility; fresh hosted installation and actual hosted selector adoption remain pending with CI.

## Description

The SDK installer authenticates the fixed archive digest before extraction/relocation, verifies cache provenance and installed-file inventory before executing cached tools, and records compiler identity. Cache keys bind the archive, host and installer contract. Workflow pins and controls track both installation steps and required-compiler calls. Exact file-pinned host SDK metadata allowances preserve the bare-metal scope gate elsewhere.

No firmware text refusal, resolver residual, product option, RTL, processor pin, scheduling rule or trusted act boundary changes. #408/#409 retain text-rule retirement.

## Reproduction

Check out `3d90958f3a82ca2a9617112c107a22f332117e17` and initialize `third_party/verilog-axis`, `protocol-processor` and `gptp-processor`. Follow the disposable-prefix installation and compiler-mode commands in docs/testing/CI_WORKFLOWS.md. Run `python3 scripts/ci_rv32_sdk_selftest.py`, `python3 sw/builder/test_firmware_compiler.py --selftest`, and the full commands in the evidence packet. Do not replace a workstation compiler for local reproduction.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Complete local source validation and integrity
- [ ] Fresh hosted compiler adoption and final-head trusted replica
- [ ] Two independent positive reviews and reviewer-owned all-five clean ledger
- [ ] Current candidate, authorized merge and clean containment
- [ ] Post-merge hosted results and Closed/Done
